title: The electrochemical and physicochemical impacts of sodium chloride on the formation of a self-healing double network hydrogel using two methods – post-treatment and in situ integration
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00476D, Paper
Mitra Najafloo, Leila Naji
The study shows how the method of impregnating PVA/SA-based GPEs with NaCl ions and also the concentration of NaCl affect the structural, morphological, mechanical, self-healing, fire-resistant, and electrochemical properties of GPEs.
